title: Wire Meal Plans tab into a real browser entry point
description: Replace the tab placeholder with a real meal-plans browser entry point and add list-entry loading logic that derives display counts from parsed plans.
acceptance_criteria: `MealPlansTab` renders the new browser view using the configured recipes folder URL.
List entry loading resolves plan files through `MealPlanFiles.discover(in:)`.
Each entry computes the deduped recipe count needed by card rows and detail headers.
No regression is introduced to the tab shell or folder-gating assumptions.
